title: Founder retains four Unit09 cardinal views as visual baseline and rejects Round24 diagonals
summary: Founder explicitly said front back and both side views look good after rejecting the four Round24 diagonal studies. Preserve those cardinal designs and proportions as the visual baseline; do not infer walk-cycle or runtime acceptance. Eight-direction target remains N NE E SE S SW W NW. Replace narrowed-cardinal and pasted-face diagonals with coherent whole-body quarter-view drawings.
source: Founder feedback in asset continuation 2026-11-12; source artwork kept private
